authority: prospective close-out protocol; frozen in git before any implementation change

relationship_to_p4.immutability: The historical P4 artifact, its cases, thresholds, per-axis results and refusal-channel definitions are IMMUTABLE and are not rewritten, corrected or erased by anything under this protocol. P4 measured the frozen router as it was: refusal real on 2 of 5 axes (response_category_count partially: only binary refused; auxiliary_modality_no_signal fully) and ABSENT on 3 (latent_dimensionality FA 120/120, observed_cell_fraction FA 80/80, factor_count FA 80/80). The longitudinal-boundary bypass for multimodal-routed requests (boundary application keyed to the answering capability, not the design) is part of the same historical record.
relationship_to_p4.framing: P4 identified declaration-enforcement gaps. P4B prospectively tests the fully wired runtime implementation. P4 is not characterized as erroneous.

objective: Determine whether runtime-derived target-design descriptors are correctly bound to output-specific executable predicates so that unsupported requested scientific outputs are suppressed, limited, or routed to fallback without altering supported METER numerical outputs.
scope_restrictions: router wiring only: no retraining, no weight change, no threshold recalibration
no new scientific support boundary is created; every wired predicate cites an already-frozen record
no capability is broadened; no failed benchmark is reinterpreted
the auxiliary admission gate is not redesigned or retuned - regression-tested only
frozen verification artifacts are not modified

response_category_count.decoder_ceiling: max item categories <= CMAX = 7 for every capability; anchor: frozen feature space (src/human_measurement/model/features.py CMAX=7, 'largest response scale in the corpus (categories 2..7)') and the release contract (release/meter/meter/api.py MAX_CATEGORIES=7). Above the ceiling the frozen decoder cannot express the item; the request is REFUSED before inference (inexpressible, same class as L46 multigroup DIF).
response_category_count.longitudinal_trained_band: for the longitudinal capabilities only, category counts outside the 5E trained band [4, 7] route the design OUT of validated support; anchor: the frozen 5E family table draws categories from {(4,), (5,), (5,7)} (src/human_measurement/model/longitudinal_worlds.py); binary (<=2) keeps its stronger measured-bias reason (6B.2.2: +0.378 share bias at 2 categories).
response_category_count.capability_specificity: cross-sectional 1D scoring keeps binary support (external_multinational_1d_zero_shot_transfer, SHARE-A EURO-D, contract v3.5) - no global category rule is created.

latent_dimensionality_and_factor_count.definition: latent_dimensionality is the dimensionality of the REQUESTED scientific operation (1D scoring -> 1, supplied K-factor scoring -> K, unrestricted discovery -> governed by the discovery contract). factor_count for supplied-structure scoring is derived from the supplied item-to-factor map and validated for internal consistency. Neither is ever populated by exploratory structure discovery.
latent_dimensionality_and_factor_count.structural_observable: on the longitudinal path the runtime observable of construct structure is the declared instrument partition (WorldTensors.item_instrument); the 5E trained envelope contains 1- and 2-construct designs only (family b5_two_construct); a longitudinal 1D scoring request over a >=3-construct battery routes OUT of validated support
latent_dimensionality_and_factor_count.supplied_structure: supplied-structure factor scoring: 1 <= K <= K_MAX = 5 (M8B; release contract); K in 3..5 confirmatory, K=2 expressible but flagged outside the confirmatory range (existing release warning); K > 5 REFUSED; density and structure conditions still apply - K <= 5 is necessary, not sufficient
latent_dimensionality_and_factor_count.discovery: unrestricted factor-count discovery and unrestricted item-to-factor discovery remain UNSUPPORTED (M7 closure; battery_structure_discovery_1_to_5 = experimental_out_of_support) and are REFUSED

observed_cell_fraction.derivation: deterministic from the observation mask: observed valid response cells / (N x T x J) applicable cells; missing sentinels, structural missing and mask-false cells are excluded by construction (mask is the single source of truth)

capability_specific_rules.supplied_structure_multidimensional: DENSE required - complete observation, the M8 closeout condition already enforced by the release contract (observed.all()); sparse multidimensional administration remains UNSUPPORTED
capability_specific_rules.longitudinal_capabilities: observed cell fraction materially below the trained envelope routes the design OUT of validated support. Trained envelope floor: 0.7 nominal item response rate (frozen 5E family e1_mcar_items; phase3 core floor 0.75). Material multiple: the existing MATERIAL_SPACING_MULTIPLE = 3.0 convention of the frozen 6B.2.3 module, applied on the density axis: fraction < 0.7 / 3.0 = 0.2333... is materially outside. This reuses the module's established material-envelope semantics rather than inventing a universal missingness threshold.
capability_specific_rules.cross_sectional_scale_wise_1d: sparse administration remains supported (D9A: SAPA ~25 observed items per person, scale-wise 1D scoring PASS); no density threshold is imposed

observed_cell_fraction.no_global_threshold: no single global missingness threshold is created; the three rules above are the existing record

auxiliary_admission.rule: UNCHANGED. The frozen reliability gate with GATE_HARD_REJECT = 0.25 clamp and structurally bit-exact psychometric fallback (fuse() returns the identical tensor objects on rejection) is regression-tested, not modified.
auxiliary_admission.provenance_extension: the gate decision is additionally recorded as an OutputDecision in the audit structure

multimodal_x_longitudinal_composition.rule: compositional, not list-based: a requested output must satisfy ALL applicable support predicates. A multimodal fusion request whose tensors are longitudinal receives the same longitudinal design evaluation as a longitudinal request; an out-of-support longitudinal design attaches the out-of-support routing, statuses and warnings to the fused result exactly as it would to a longitudinal result. No request escapes one capability boundary because another module owns the final output.

phi_factor_covariance.rule: UNCHANGED from the release contract: real-data Phi interpretation NOT SUPPORTED (D9B REPLICATION_FAIL) - suppressed unless data positively declared synthetic; synthetic dense within the validated regime remains a diagnostic output (M8). Wired as an output-specific decision on the same input that permits factor scores.

architecture_under_test.canonical_descriptor: one runtime DesignDescriptor derived from the delivered tensors and request declarations (response category counts from explicit metadata/valid observed levels excluding sentinels and mask values; observed cell fraction from the mask; factor_count from the supplied map with consistency validation; latent_dimensionality from the requested operation; construct structure from the declared instrument partition; longitudinal_design; auxiliary_modality_present; requested_output_types)
architecture_under_test.output_specific_authorization: support is evaluated separately per requested output (no single global boolean); each output receives one of PERMIT / LIMIT / FALLBACK / REFUSE mapped onto the existing status vocabularies (interface.Status for routing, 6B.2.3 capability statuses for design meaning); the same input may receive different decisions for different requested outputs
architecture_under_test.emission_control: a refused scientific quantity is absent from the authoritative outputs (suppression, the existing load-bearing rule), never serialized with a warning attached; internal diagnostics needed to determine support are separated from authorized outputs
architecture_under_test.decision_record: every requested output gets an OutputDecision record: output_type, action, predicates_evaluated, predicate_results, warnings, fallback_used, refusal_code, evidence_refs, contract_version, enforcement_state; carried in result provenance so a single run is auditable
architecture_under_test.frozen_status_vocabularies_untouched: interface.Status stays exactly five values; the 10-capability table and UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATIONS stay unchanged; new vocabulary lives in the router module only

evaluation_plan.step_1_unit_and_adversarial_tests: deterministic tests: supported 1D ordinal scoring; supported dense supplied-structure K in range; supported sparse scale-wise 1D; same-input different-output (factor scores permit / Phi refuse / discovery refuse / factor-count discovery refuse); boundary refusals (categories, K, density, missing supplied structure); multimodal admission/no-signal/mismatch/exact-fallback; cross-boundary (multimodal+longitudinal, sparse+multidimensional, supplied structure+covariance request); runnable-but-unsupported refusal; refused outputs asserted absent from authoritative serialized output
evaluation_plan.step_2_original_p4_rerun: rerun the original P4 challenge set with cases, thresholds, seeds, refusal-channel definitions and decision rule UNCHANGED (frozen block read from configs/model/planned_analyses_preregistration.json; P4 seed region reused by import, not retyped); results written to a NEW artifact (reports/planned/p4b_rerun_original_p4.json); the historical artifact is not touched; before/after per-axis table produced
evaluation_plan.step_3_fresh_challenge: a modest fresh challenge set of previously unseen combinations, frozen here in fresh_challenge_design; deterministic synthetic/hand-constructed designs only; seed region [989000, 989499] within the registered validation region, asserted disjoint from every declared region and from the P4 region [988000, 988999]
evaluation_plan.step_4_numerical_non_regression: pre/post-router comparison on supported fixtures: respondent scores, supported item outputs, supported relative uncertainty, exact fallback outputs; BIT IDENTITY required (the existing pipeline is deterministic; no new tolerance rule is introduced)
evaluation_plan.step_5_artifact: single close-out artifact reports/planned/p4b_fully_wired_capability_router.json recording protocol hash, baseline commit, implementation commit, model digests, contract digest, historical P4 results, unchanged-P4 rerun, fresh results, non-regression and fallback results, representative output-granular examples, verdict

primary: original P4 rerun: false accepts = 0 and false rejects = 0 on every one of the five frozen axes, under the UNCHANGED P4 decision rule
fresh challenge: false accepts = 0 and false refusals = 0
longitudinal x multimodal regression: an out-of-envelope longitudinal design routed through fusion receives the longitudinal out-of-support routing (bypass closed)
safety_and_integrity: supported numerical outputs bit-identical pre/post wiring

refused outputs absent from authoritative serialized outputs
every output decision records provenance: descriptor values, predicates evaluated, results, contract version
auxiliary gate regression: no-signal rejection preserved, gate decision recorded
acceptance_criteria.verdict_rule: PASS only if every primary and safety criterion is met; REFINE if wiring is correct but any criterion is unmet for identified reasons; FAIL if unsupported outputs still escape or supported numerics changed

append_only: this protocol is append-only after the freeze commit; any amendment must be a dated append that does not alter the frozen criteria
